sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: 📊 Unique-values dropdown: sections are now grouped by topic. One main header per topic ("Entity info", "Title info", …) holds its sub-sections, each shown as an italic "» Artist name:" heading. Entries show only their value: "Bruce Springsteen" instead of "» artist name: Bruce Springsteen" repeated on every line. The quick filter still matches the full text, so typing "artist name" still finds them. A topic with only one sub-section gets a single header line, e.g. "Video info › Medium format". Both headers carry a tooltip.

📊 Unique-values dropdown: main headers and sub-headings both collapse. Click toggles one. Ctrl+Click on a main header applies to every main header. Ctrl+Click on a sub-heading applies to every sub-section of the same topic.

📊 Unique-values dropdown: a sub-section with more entries than the new setting "Unique-Values Dropdown: Auto-Collapse Sub-Sections Above" (default 15, 0 = off) opens collapsed and shows its entry count. A sub-section you expand yourself stays expanded on the next open. Ctrl+Click "expand all" does not count, so auto-collapse keeps working. Collapse states saved by earlier versions are kept, but their "expanded" marks are dropped once, because those versions had no auto-collapse.
New setting "Unique-Values Dropdown: Group Sections By Topic" (default on). Turn it off to get the previous flat layout back.
